The Haunted House

Sarah stood before the old mansion, rain pouring down. The door creaked open by itself. Inside, she heard whispers calling her name. Shadows danced on the walls, forming faces. A cold hand touched her shoulder. She turned but no one was there. The whispers grew louder, promising secrets. Suddenly, the lights flickered and went out. When they returned, Sarah was gone, leaving only her phone on the floor, showing a picture of the empty house.
